content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for 176 Home Guard Volunteers, divided as below. Most of the vacancies, 127 of 176, are for regular Home Guards.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the qualifications, criteria and documents below as on 31 December 2026. They must also hold a 15 years Residence Certificate of Goa issued by the Competent Authority, Government of Goa. Both male and female candidates can apply, as the notice gives separate height and fitness standards for each. Age is counted as on the last date of receipt of application forms, i.e. 31.12.2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. For both posts: S.S.C.E. passed from a recognized Board or equivalent qualification. The candidate should be proficient in swimming. The candidate should belong to the fisherman community and be residing in the coastal areas. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

rows.age_limit: Not less than 20 years and not more than 50 years
Not less than 20 years and not more than 30 years

rows.male: 1 KM to be completed in 4 minutes 30 seconds
rows.female: 800 Mtrs to be completed in 4 minutes 30 seconds

content_sections.heading: Duty Allowance, Term and Training
content_sections.text: The present Duty Allowance paid to a Home Guard Volunteer is ₹962/- per day. Enrolment is initially for a period of three (03) years only. Enrolled Home Guard Volunteers undergo 45 days basic training at Police Training School, Valpoi. Those enrolled as Marine Home Guards will have to undergo further training at specialized training centers. Training allowances will be paid as per prescribed rates. A Home Guard Volunteer or Marine Home Guard shall perform duty in any part of the State of Goa.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice names these stages: verification of original documents before the Enrolment Boards, physical measurement, physical fitness test and a written test. Marine Home Guard candidates also take a swimming test. Enrolment is done strictly for candidates who qualify in documents verification, physical measurement and the physical fitness test, and is based on merit in the written test. Candidates must produce original certificates or documents before the Enrolment Boards, such as the Birth Certificate, Educational Qualification Certificates from a recognized Institute, 15 years Residence Certificate, Professional Skills, NCC Certificate, Sports Certificate and Ex-Serviceman Certificate. Only eligible candidates go to the next stage. Candidates who fail to produce the requisite original documents as on 31.12.2026 will be eliminated, and no candidate will be allowed provisionally. Height is checked against 165 cms for males and 155 cms for females. In the fitness test, males run 1 KM and females run 800 Mtrs, each within 4 minutes 30 seconds. The written test carries 100 marks. The minimum passing mark is 35. A candidate who scores less than 35 marks will be declared "Failed" and will not be considered for the further selection process. The notice does not give the subjects or the duration of the test. A swimming test shall be conducted through the competent authority for Marine Home Guard candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Goa Home Guard Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Collect the prescribed Application Form from the Office of the Home Guards & Civil Defence Organisation, Second Floor, Goa Reserve Police Camp, Altinho, Panaji-Goa, from 25 November 2026. Forms are issued on all working days from 10.00 hrs to 13.00 hrs and 14.00 hrs to 17.30 hrs, on payment of Rs.20/- per form. Fill in the form completely. Do not attach any certificates or documents. Submit the form personally at the Enrolment Cell in the Office of the Commandant General Home Guards & Director, Civil Defence, Goa Reserve Police Camp, Altinho, Panaji-Goa, on or before 31 December 2026. At submission, show photocopies of the 15 years Residence Certificate of Goa, the passing certificate of Educational Qualification and the Birth Certificate. These photocopies will be returned to you. Collect the acknowledgement of receipt, which is issued on the spot. Wait for the call letter for the Selection Test, which will be sent by post at a later stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Goa Home Guard Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 176 vacancies: 127 regular Home Guards and 49 Marine Home Guards.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the Goa Home Guard application form?
faq.answer: The completed form must be submitted in person on or before 31 December 2026. Forms received after that date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Goa Home Guard posts?
faq.answer: S.S.C.E. passed from a recognized Board or equivalent qualification, plus a 15 years Residence Certificate of Goa.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Goa Home Guard Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Home Guard Volunteers must be not less than 20 and not more than 50 years. Marine Home Guards must be not less than 20 and not more than 30 years, both as on 31.12.2026.

faq.question: Q5. How much is the duty allowance for a Goa Home Guard?
faq.answer: The present Duty Allowance paid to a Home Guard Volunteer is ₹962/- per day.

faq.question: Q6. What is the cost of the application form?
faq.answer: The prescribed form costs Rs.20/- per form, payable when you collect it at the Home Guards & Civil Defence office, Altinho, Panaji.

faq.question: Q7. Can I send the Goa Home Guard form by post?
faq.answer: No. Forms received by post or courier will not be accepted; you must submit the form personally at the Enrolment Cell.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection involves document verification, physical measurement, a physical fitness test and a 100-mark written test with 35 as the passing mark. Marine Home Guard candidates also take a swimming test.

faq.question: Q9. Who can apply for the Marine Home Guard posts?
faq.answer: Candidates who are proficient in swimming and belong to the fisherman community residing in the coastal areas, besides meeting the age, qualification and residence conditions.

faq.question: Q10. Is the Goa Home Guard enrolment permanent?
faq.answer: No. The enrolment is initially for a period of three (03) years only.
